justification: `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/compilation/CompilationUtil.java` is a central static utility with broad fan-out: it defines 8 public helpers and directly depends on `Compilation`, `Task`, `Tag`, `IMetaMember`, `IParseDictionary`, `LogParseException`, `ParseUtil`, `StringUtil`, and many `JITWatchConstants`. Fan-in is also high: 15 other source files reference it (`BytecodeAnnotationBuilder`, `CompileChainWalker`, `HeadlessInlineVisitor`, `IntrinsicFinder`, `HotThrowFinder`, `SuggestionWalker`, `InlineSizeHistoVisitable`, `InliningFailReasonTopListVisitable`, `StaleTaskToplistVisitable`, `CompilationTableRow`, `AbstractCompilationVisitable`, and 4 tests), with multiple classes calling `visitParseTagsOfCompilation` and `isStaleTask`.
